description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Ashe''' fires a massive arrow of ice in the target direction, briefly granting [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the area it flies through. The arrow shatters upon hitting an enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]], dealing them magic damage, [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stunning]] them for 1 – 3.5 (based on distance traveled)[[Category:Debug]] seconds, and granting [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the area around them for 1 second.
description.text: Active: Ashe fires a massive arrow of ice in the target direction, briefly granting sight of the area it flies through. The arrow shatters upon hitting an enemy champion, dealing them magic damage, stunning them for 1 – 3.5 (based on distance traveled)Category:Debug seconds, and granting sight of the area around them for 1 second.

description2.raw: Enemies surrounding the primary target are dealt the same damage and afflicted with ''[[File:Ashe Frost Shot.png|20xpx|border|link=Ashe#Frost Shot|An icon for Ashe's ability Frost Shot]] [[Ashe#Frost Shot|Frost Shot]]''.
description2.text: Enemies surrounding the primary target are dealt the same damage and afflicted with Frost Shot.

leveling.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
200 / 300 / 400 / 500 / 600 (+ 120% AP)

notes.raw:
* ''Enchanted Crystal Arrow's'' projectile has an [[File:Enchanted Crystal Arrow Minimap.png|40px|link=]] icon on the mini-map while it is in flight. It can be seen by only '''Ashe''' and her allies.
* This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the start of the cast time.
* The effect will be centered on the first champion struck, not at the location the missile collided with them.
